checkpoints.title: Answer policy: screen questions, ground answers
contracts: policy.Screen(question) refuses personal-data and advice questions, empty or over 500 bytes; policy.Ground(score, citations) answers at score >= 0.5 with a citation, else refers to HR
instrumentation: every non-answer verdict carries a reason code and the message shown to the asker

checkpoints.title: BM25 retrieval of the best plan passage with a grounding score
contracts: answer.New(passages).Answer(question) returns the top passage quoted in full with one citation {passage_id, plan, section} and Score = share of the question's terms it holds
instrumentation: Result.Score is returned for the workflow to record and policy to judge

bypass.note: solo mode: no second person exists to review the plan, and no one reviewed it as the Engineering Manager (Appendix B D2)
